query: SELECT cp.status, cp.ar_id, ar.id as ar_real_id FROM cobranca_planilha cp LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON cp.ar_id = ar.id WHERE cp.ar_id IS NOT NULL AND ar.id NOT IN (SELECT receivableId FROM collection_actions) LIMIT 10;
